items.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.body: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
items.body: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.body: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.
